title: focus-cadence-logbook-leah-morgan
content:
Context:
This is my personal cadence log for a 6-week sprint chunk (rolling). Mix of OKR drafts, scratch hypotheses, and weekly check-ins. Intended to keep small experiments visible and avoid scope creep. Not polished — notes to self.

Objective (personal): Improve production inference economics and reduce operational firefighting so I can spend more time on model-serving improvements and mentoring.

Key Results (first 6 weeks):
- KR1: Reduce 95p latency for /v1/generate (long prompts) from 420ms -> 360ms (15% reduction). Baseline measured 2026-02-20.
- KR2: Lower average token compute cost for hosted-small-tier by 12% via batching/kv-cache optimizations. Baseline $0.00095/token.
- KR3: Ship autoscaling policy alpha for Dedicated with documented rollback behaviour and one customer pilot.
- KR4: Run 4 prompt-evals and show no >3% regression in quality vs baseline for the chosen quantized model.
- KR5: Hold 3 paired sessions mentoring new infra hires (goal: 6 hours total).

Signals I’ll watch (daily/weekly):
- P95 latency per route (alert threshold 380ms)
- Tokens/sec throughput for small-gpu pools
- Cost per million tokens (rolling 7d)
- Eval pass rate (percentage of prompts within acceptable confidence)
- Number of incidents where fallback executed (target: 0 for this cycle)

This week (checkpoint 1: 2026-03-02):
- Wins:
  * Built an experiment harness that profiles KV cache hit ratio by prefix length (ran across 3 routes).
  * Cut a PR that adds micro-batching with dynamic window (GH-PR-3247) — bench results look promising (avg latency +3ms, p95 -18ms under steady load).
  * Mentored Priya for 2h on tracing patterns.
- Open questions / to validate:
  * Is the cache eviction policy hurting long-conversational workloads? Observed lower hit ratio for seq>1024. Need synthetic replay.
  * Does dynamic micro-batching increase tail latency under bursty traffic? Add chaos-in-prod simulation.
- Blockers:
  * Need access to customer A's long-history workload dataset for more realistic replay (raised in #serving-runtime).
  * Perf infra quota exhausted for full-scale replay — ask infra to bump for 48h.

Micro-experiments (planned and running):
1) Prefix clustering for KV caching (running): group requests by prefix fingerprint and prewarm cache for hot clusters. Success metric: +10pp hit ratio on top-10 clusters.
2) Adaptive batch window (alpha) (merged to staging): dynamically shrink/expand window by traffic variance. Success metric: p95 latency down 10-20ms with <5% throughput loss.
3) Quantization profile A/B (scheduled): test 8-bit QK and hybrid kernel selection. Success metric: cost/token -12% with eval pass rate >=97%.

Daily ritual (short):
- Morning (10m): quick glance at dashboard: p95, cost, incidents. Note anomalies.
- Midday (15m): run one micro-replay or benchmark if experiment is active.
- End of day (10m): update this log with one-line outcome.

Retrospective notes (end of week, freeform):
- I tend to scope too many hypotheses at once. Need to drop to max 2 active micro-experiments to avoid context switching.
- Paired sessions are high leverage — schedule them fixed Tue/Thu.
- Communication: write a short (1-par) summary for the Product weekly sync to align Dedicated pilot expectations.

Actionables (next 7 days):
- Finish synthetic replay for conversations >1024 tokens (owner: me).
- Request perf infra quota bump (owner: me; target 2026-03-04).
- Draft alpha runbook for autoscaling policy and post to Confluence (owner: me + Amina).
- Book 2 mentoring slots on calendar and invite Priya and Ravi.

Quick metrics snapshot (2026-03-06):
- p95 /v1/generate: 395ms (target 360ms)
- avg token cost (hosted-small): $0.00092/token (target $0.00084)
- KV cache hit ratio (top routes): 43% (prior 39%)
- Eval pass rate (quant-A pilot): 98% on quick set
- Active micro-experiments: 2 (prefix-cluster, adaptive-batch)

Notes to self (fragments):
- If autoscaler alpha relies on container startup < 12s, store warm standby snapshots.
- Consider adding a per-route latency SLO tag to the dashboard so product can filter expectations.
- Revisit 'fallback to smaller model' policy: need to quantify quality drop vs cost savings for each route.

Checkpoint (next): 2026-03-09 — short writeup and go/no-go on scaling the adaptive batching to customer pilot.

End of log entry.
